title: Line sketch: Swirling and Loops
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Abstract composition of overlapping circular swirls, organic loops, and fluid tendrils in, and tones on a white ground. Dynamic create movement and depth through layered translucent colors and varying line weights. The arrangement balances dense spiral clusters with lighter, open negative space (derived from painting #1).
